title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Geriatric Health in Nigeria
summary: A research project evaluating whether synthetic data generated from a small (N=134) geriatric hypertension dataset from Ibadan, Nigeria can safely augment machine learning models while preserving privacy, comparing statistical vs deep-learning generators across fidelity, utility, and privacy dimensions. It uses SDV's single-table API, running GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate the synthetic clinical data evaluated throughout the study.
